core_obligations: (1)⇒(2): ideal-sheaf injectivity from flatness, local trivialization of the sheafified tensor, unwind relations via the Algebra relations lemma.
(2)⇒(3): induction on the number of columns; apply (2) to the last column, kill it, and induct with the refined coverings.
(3)⇒(1): reduce injectivity to sections, decompose F(U) into a filtered colimit of finitely presented modules, apply (3) to a presentation, and conclude via the free case.
proof_roadmap: ideal-sheaf injectivity + column induction + filtered-colimit presentation chase
difficulty_reason: Three implications fully executed: (1)⇒(2) via the ideal sheaf I generated by the f_j, injectivity of I ⊗ F|_U → F|_U from flatness (lemma-restriction-flat, delivered), local trivialization of the sheafified tensor product over a covering, and unwinding via Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-relations; (2)⇒(3) by induction on the number of columns m with the displayed factorizations and the zero last column; (3)⇒(1) by the sheafification reduction to sections of presheaf tensor products, the filtered-colimit decomposition F(U) = colim M_alpha into finitely presented modules (Algebra), tensor-commutation with filtered colimits (Algebra), a presentation of M_alpha, application of (3), and the injectivity of tensoring with a free module.
